segments.text:
Whome God electeth, them he calleth in the time appointed for the same purpose. This calling of the Elect is nothing els but a singling and a seuering of them out of this vile world, and the customes thereof, to be
citizens of the
kingdome of glorie after this life. And the time of their calling is tearmed in Scriptures,
the day of visitation, the day of saluation, the time of grace.
